commands.name: bracket_tests
commands.summary: 7 passed across 3 suites; includes subprocess SIGKILL checkpoint/resume and exact cache controls.

positive_checks: Independent bracket-owned bolt/support/load/material/bounds contract and fixture objectives contain no hydrocyclone geometry or DSD constants.
Bounded synthetic campaign reconciles all 3 attempt ordinals; material and load scenario are included in exact evaluation identity.
crucible-store exact cache lookup hits unchanged evaluation identity and misses after a bolt-location change; material changes alter subject identity and screen output.
Subprocess SIGKILL after syncing a nonempty campaign checkpoint; resumed state preserves ordinal 0 and finishes ordinals 1 and 2 without duplicate or reset.
Offline SVG card binds the subject SHA-256 and load source; labels force [N], moment [N m], stress [MPa], mass [g], material evidence, and blocked qualification.
Cargo.lock adds pack-bracket only; no dependency versions/sources changed. Workspace registration is draft lane scaffolding.
negative_checks: Out-of-bounds support web and duplicate/out-of-envelope bolt layouts are rejected.
A disabled oil judge without the frozen rule, or with caller-invented reason/domain, is rejected.
Unknown campaign fields, including a hydrocyclone-like flow field, are rejected by strict TOML decoding.
Changed bolt locations cannot inherit the prior structural observation through exact cache; changed material changes identity.
No flow fields are rendered; physical qualification remains blocked in output.
limitations: The repository has no general partition/observer/native structural adapter runner. The campaign uses a pack-owned elementary beam and four-bolt screen and pack-owned checkpoint driver; it does not execute through a shared native structural adapter.
The shared common scene/data-card registry is absent. Pack-specific SVG recipe is used; hydrocyclone templates are not invoked.

Structural output is a synthetic software screen, not validated FEA. No as-built identity, material passport, manufacturing/process review, fatigue, corrosion, service, or physical validation is present.
Karambit port deferred to its own authorization.
next_dependency: Integrator registration of general partition/observer/native-structure runner and common scene registry; separate evidence gates for structural validation and manufacturing/service claims.
